grupo.hero-lead: A capoeira school connected by culture, discipline, music, and community.
grupo.hist-lead: Pura Capoeira was born as a community dedicated to living capoeira fully: as fight, art, music, history, culture, and a path of personal formation.
grupo.hist-p1: The school brings together professors, instructors, students, and training hubs in different cities, maintaining a common foundation of respect, discipline, musicality, and fundamentals.
grupo.hist-p2: That is why Pura Capoeira is not limited to teaching movements: it seeks to develop capoeiristas with body, musical, cultural, and historical awareness.
grupo.hist-quote: "Capoeira is transmitted in the roda, in training, in singing, in the berimbau rhythm, and in the coexistence between generations."
grupo.value-1-text: Consistency, presence, and commitment to practice.
grupo.value-2-text: Toward the mestre, toward partners, toward history.
grupo.value-3-text: Berimbau, singing, and rhythm: the heart of the roda.
grupo.value-5-text: Capoeira is not lived alone: it is lived with others.
grupo.value-7-text: The jogo is dialogue, intelligence, and malicia.
grupo.value-8-text: What sustains everything: tradition, ethics, and meaning.
grupo.values-lead: Eight principles that guide our practice inside and outside the roda.
grupo.vision-lead: Develop capoeiristas capable of jogar, singing, playing instruments, understanding history, and representing capoeira with respect inside and outside the roda.
grupo.vision-text: We work with students of all ages - kids, teens, youth, and adults - to build a practice that lasts a lifetime.

inicio.cta-text: Classes for adults, kids, teens, and youth. Music, jogo, and culture.
inicio.hero-lead: Pura Capoeira is a school and community dedicated to preserving, teaching, and sharing capoeira as art, fight, music, Afro-Brazilian culture, discipline, and personal development.
inicio.hero-sub: Capoeira, culture, music, and movement connecting communities.
inicio.intro-lead: Pura Capoeira is a community of capoeiristas connected by practice, music, roda, Afro-Brazilian culture, and respect for capoeira history.
inicio.intro-p1: Each location has its own local context, but shares one foundation: train with discipline, play with intelligence, sing with fundamentals, and strengthen community.
inicio.intro-p2: Capoeira is fight, art, music, history, strategy, and personal development. It is not fitness, not dance, not just sport. It is living culture.
inicio.sedes-lead: Professors, hubs, and community in six cities around the world. Find the location closest to you.
